Enterprise Account Executive

Autodesk is seeking an Enterprise Account Executive to strategically grow and expand relationships across high-value enterprise accounts. This role is responsible for leading comprehensive account growth strategies, driving incremental revenue, expanding product adoption, and positioning Autodesk as a long-term strategic partner to customers undergoing digital transformation.
The Enterprise Account Executive will own strategic executive relationships, account planning, revenue generation, pipeline management, complex deal negotiations, and orchestration of cross-functional account teams. This role goes beyond execution: it requires the ability to refine and innovate account strategies, influence executive stakeholders, lead high-complexity commercial motions, and drive measurable business outcomes for both Autodesk and the customer.
This role is suited for an experienced enterprise sales leader who can operate with senior decision-makers, navigate complex customer organizations, lead matrixed teams, and create scalable growth opportunities across EBA and non-EBA enterprise accounts.

Strategic Account Growth
Lead and refine comprehensive growth strategies for assigned enterprise accounts, including EBA and non-EBA customers
Develop multi-year strategic account plans aligned to customer priorities, Autodesk growth objectives, and long-term value creation
Identify and pursue expansion opportunities across new business units, buyer groups, personas, and use cases
Drive buyer seat expansion and product adoption across complex customer organizations
Lead QBRs, executive check-ins, and senior stakeholder engagement to review progress, business outcomes, risks, and future growth opportunities
Innovate account strategies that create scalable growth models and influence broader business outcomes
Revenue Generation & Pipeline Management
Maximize incremental revenue through upsell, cross-sell, upgraded products, new offerings, and EBA token consumption strategies
Own pipeline development, pipeline health, and forecasting accuracy for growth, expansion, and renewal opportunities
Use data-driven insights to assess account potential, customer spend trends, adoption signals, whitespace, and risk
Proactively adjust account tactics based on customer priorities, market changes, competitive dynamics, and business goals
Deliver predictable revenue performance while identifying transformational opportunities that support long-term customer and Autodesk growth
Executive Relationship Management
Build and maintain strategic relationships with C-level executives, senior decision-makers, and key influencers across assigned accounts
Adapt communication style to diverse executive audiences and manage challenging conversations with confidence, empathy, and business relevance
Act as a trusted advisor by connecting Autodesk capabilities to the customer’s strategic objectives and transformation priorities
Develop compelling executive narratives that articulate business value, ROI, competitive differentiation, and long-term partnership opportunities
Secure and maintain executive sponsorship for strategic initiatives, commercial agreements, and expansion opportunities
Complex Deal Strategy & Commercial Execution
Lead complex enterprise negotiations, including expansions, renewals, multi-year agreements, and high-value commercial structures
Build value-based business cases that quantify customer impact and support executive decision-making
Navigate procurement, commercial, legal, and stakeholder complexity to progress opportunities and mitigate risk
Mentor teams in complex deal negotiations and help shape strategic deal approaches across large enterprise opportunities
Account Team Unit / Cross-Functional Orchestration
Strategically lead partnerships with the extended sales team, Technical Sales, Customer Success, Consulting, Marketing, Partner teams, and executive stakeholders
Orchestrate the Account Team Unit to co-develop scalable, impactful customer solutions
Align technical discovery, messaging, value proposition, and commercial strategy to customer needs
Drive accountability across internal teams through clear ownership, communication, and execution cadence
Ensure seamless post-sale handoff to Customer Success for onboarding, implementation, adoption, and ongoing relationship management
Serve as an escalation point for customer challenges and internal alignment issues
Partner with Customer Success and Consulting teams to ensure customers achieve measurable business outcomes from Autodesk solutions
Industry, Competitive & Business Leadership
Maintain deep knowledge of the customer’s industry, business model, transformation priorities, competitive landscape, and regulatory environment
Translate industry challenges into tailored Autodesk solutions and differentiated value propositions
Provide customer and market insights to internal Sales, Product, Strategy, and Marketing teams
Influence Autodesk’s go-to-market approach by sharing enterprise customer needs, competitive intelligence, and emerging market opportunities
Represent Autodesk as a strategic thought partner in executive-level customer conversations

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
10+ years of enterprise sales, strategic account management, or consultative business development experience
Proven success managing complex enterprise accounts and driving significant revenue growth
Experience engaging C-level executives and senior stakeholders across large, matrixed customer organizations
Demonstrated ability to lead complex commercial negotiations, renewals, expansions, and multi-year enterprise agreements
Strong track record of pipeline generation, forecast accuracy, and revenue attainment
Experience leading cross-functional account teams, including Technical Sales, Customer Success, Consulting, Marketing, Partner, Legal, Finance, and Deal Desk stakeholders
Strong business acumen, analytical thinking, executive communication, and consultative selling skills

Experience in enterprise SaaS, cloud, platform, digital transformation, or technology solution sales
Familiarity with Autodesk’s Architecture, Engineering, and Construction customer segments and the business challenges, workflows, and digital transformation priorities within the AECO industry
Experience leading strategic customer transformations, large-scale adoption programs, or executive-sponsored growth initiatives
Advanced skills in value-based selling, ROI modeling, business case development, and executive storytelling
Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM and account planning tools
Experience mentoring account teams or influencing sales strategy beyond assigned accounts

Hello. We’re Teya . Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better. They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving.

Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business. Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support.

Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work. We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you What will you be doing? As we continue to expand our operations in the UK, we’re looking for our third Sales Manager to join our expanding Independent Sales Agent channel.

This is a fast paced, high velocity, transactional field team made up of freelance sellers. With the support of our dedicated recruitment team, you will be responsible for growing the team from 0 to ~60 people over the coming months and delivering our revenue goals.

Ultimately you will also be responsible for: Leading, managing and developing a dynamic team of commission-only sales representatives of varying levels of experience, ensuring alignment with company goals and objectives Working hands-on with the team, designing and implementing effective sales processes to drive revenue growth Providing initial training for new sellers and then ongoing mentorship to develop individuals and increase their volume of monthly sales Conduct regular reviews with individuals to ensure their continuous engagement with Teya and create a long-term partnership Collaborate with cross-functional teams including marketing and product development to act as a voice of the seller and ensure we have the best tools available to our team Analyse sales data and performance metrics to identify areas for improvement to increase channel growth What are we looking for?

Proven track record of successful field sales management experience, preferably in the payments industry or a related field Demonstratable experience of designing and implementing sales training for a variety of experience levels Strong leadership and team management skills with the ability to motivate and inspire a commission-only sales team to achieve and exceed targets Demonstrated ability to develop and implement strategic sales plans that align with overall business objectives.

Proactive and results-oriented with a focus on continuous improvement and a willingness to take initiative in a dynamic and competitive market. Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

Knowledge of relevant industry trends, competitors, and market dynamics is preferable Ability to travel as needed to meet with sellers, attend industry events and support the sales team in various locations. What can we offer you?

On top of your basic salary you will be able to earn uncapped commissions 25 days of Annual Leave + Bank Holidays Physical and mental health support through our partnership with GymPass, 1-1 therapy sessions, meditation sessions and access to digital fitness and nutrition apps Extended and improved maternity and paternity leave choices Private Medical and Life Insurance Improved pension Scheme Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us. Originally posted on Himalayas

Do you want the challenge — and the reward — of building your own book of business? At Keycafe , we’re looking for an Account Executive who thrives on creating new opportunities, closing deals, and owning an entire territory or industry segment.

This isn’t account management or order processing — it’s a chance to be entrepreneurial inside a growing SaaS/IoT company and essentially build a business of your own. What You’ll Do Own a market — you will be focused on the Australian market, and you’ll be responsible for growing our top segments as if it were your own business.

Run high-impact demos that clearly show prospects how our SmartBox product solves their operational challenges. Drive the full sales cycle: prospecting, outreach, demos, negotiation, and close. Experiment and adapt — try new outreach methods, refine your pitch, and find creative ways to break through.

Collaborate across teams to ensure smooth handoffs and long-term customer success. Why Join Keycafe Entrepreneurial ownership: AEs at Keycafe own entire industries or countries, giving you the chance to build your own business line inside the company.

Global impact: Our SmartBox is trusted by customers worldwide, from small businesses to large organizations. Startup culture with reach: Be part of a fast-growing SaaS/IoT company where your ideas matter and your success is highly visible.

About Keycafe Keycafe , headquartered in Vancouver and with a team spanning the globe, powers secure and seamless key management for businesses worldwide. Our SmartBox system combines IoT hardware with cloud software to give organizations total control over their keys — anytime, anywhere.

From hospitality and property management to logistics, fleets, and government, companies rely on Keycafe to keep operations secure, efficient, and scalable. Requirements Who You Are 2+ years of B2B SaaS or high-velocity sales experience with a track record of consistently closing new business.

A self-starter who’s energized by ownership — you don’t just run plays, you create them. Resilient and resourceful — you keep moving after rejection and find new ways to win. Passionate about learning products and showing customers how they can transform operations.

Startup-minded — flexible, collaborative, and willing to contribute beyond your immediate role. Nice to Have Sales experience in industries like hospitality, property management, fleet/logistics, facilities/security, first responder, or government services. Background in IoT, access control, or hardware-enabled SaaS.

Benefits Base salary $60,000 - $70,000 AUD plus uncapped commission, expected OTE $95,000 - $110,000 AUD. Remote-friendly with flexibility to own your territory or industry. Opportunity to build and grow your own business line within a scaling SaaS/IoT company. Work with a tangible, innovative product already trusted by businesses worldwide.

Career growth and visibility — your success is highly visible in a company where results matter. Originally posted on Himalayas

About First Connect: First Connect Insurance Services is a digital platform providing independent insurance agents access to top US carriers and the optionality necessary to grow their businesses. Agents can work with over 150 carriers, selling various insurance policies, including home, auto, small business, and more.

We’re on a mission to overhaul the technology agents have access to, putting consumer-grade software at their fingertips. We’ve got thousands of active agents with hundreds joining monthly, and we plan to accelerate our growth.

The Role: First Connect is seeking an Account Manager to oversee client relationships to maintain and elevate production of new agents on our digital insurance platform. In this role, you will manage key accounts, drive growth of clients early in their tenure on the platform, and ensure exceptional client satisfaction.

The Account Manager’s primary goal is to increase agent knowledge, understanding, and production with appointed carriers, while also supporting expansion with other carriers.

You should be well-versed in the P&C insurance industry, have in-depth knowledge of the market, and be detail-oriented in training on new products, processes, and best practices.

What You’ll Do: Serve as the primary point of contact for clients after onboarding Develop and maintain strong relationships with key-stakeholders Schedule, coordinate, and conduct agent training sessions Identify opportunities for upselling, cross-selling, and new business development Use data-driven analysis to identify trends and opportunities for growth Collect and communicate feedback from training sessions to relevant departments to drive improvements Improve agency production by training new agencies and identifying/removing obstacles affecting current production Identify high performing agencies and work collaboratively with other internal teams to ensure a smooth transition to additional points of contact.

Maintain in-depth knowledge of all carrier markets, products, commission structures, and appointment processes What You’ll Bring: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience 5+ years of experience marketing P&C insurance, including marketing to Independent Agents Experience training and developing agency staff Strong problem-solving and communication skills Ability to evaluate agency qualifications for appointment and make recommendations for appointment or dismissal Experience selling and marketing P&C personal lines and commercial products (homeowners and personal auto experience a plus) Excellent written, oral, and presentation skills for both small and large groups Active TDI P&C license required; CPCU and/or CIC designation desirable Self-motivated and directed; able to work autonomously while collaborating effectively Strong intellectual curiosity and desire to help others solve problems Flexible and willing to do what is needed to get great work done Benefits & Perks: First Connect treats its team members with the same level of dedication and care as we do our customers, which is why we’re fortunate to provide our team with: Multiple medical plans to choose from and 100% employer-covered dental; vision plans for our team members and their families A 401(k) retirement plan, short- and long-term disability, employer-paid life insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) for health and dependent care, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) Equity — This position is eligible for equity compensation Training and Career Growth — Training and internal career growth opportunities Flexible Time Off — You know when and how you should recharge The base pay range for this role is $65,000 - $75,000 annually, with target sales commissions totaling an additional $30,000 annually.

Exact compensation may vary based on several job-related factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to: skill set, experience, education/training, location, business needs, and market demands.

First Connect is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to building a team culture that celebrates diversity and inclusion. Applicants are considered solely based on their qualifications, without regard to an applicant’s disability or need for accommodation.

Any First Connect applicant who requires reasonable accommodations during the application process should contact the First Connect People Team to make the need for an accommodation known. Originally posted on Himalayas

About Huzzle
At Huzzle , we connect exceptional B2B sales professionals with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries such as SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech. Unlike an outsourcing agency, we place you directly with a client where you’re hired in-house as a valued member of their team.

We are hiring a results-drivenAccount Executiveto join one of our international client teams. In this role, you will own the full sales cycle — from conducting discovery calls and product demos to negotiating contracts and closing deals.
This opportunity is ideal for experienced sales professionals with strong consultative selling skills who are confident managing pipeline, forecasting revenue, and consistently hitting targets.

Manage the full sales cycle from qualified lead to closed deal
Conduct discovery calls to understand client needs and pain points
Deliver product demos and tailored sales presentations
Build and manage a consistent sales pipeline within CRM systems (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, etc.)
Negotiate pricing and contract terms with decision-makers
Consistently meet or exceed monthly and quarterly revenue targets
Collaborate with SDRs/BDRs and marketing teams to improve lead quality

2–5+ years of experience in B2B sales or closing roles

Proficiency with CRM systems and sales engagement tools
Excellent English communication skills (verbal and written)
Professional remote work setup with reliable internet

Experience in SaaS, tech, digital marketing, or subscription-based businesses
Experience selling to international markets (UK, US, Canada, Australia)

As a trusted leader in AI, Amazon, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions—integrating Salesforce Einstein, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, Agentforce and more—to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results.

From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies.
We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post-launch, we’ve earned the distinction of being Salesforce’s #1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space.
Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Here, you’ll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes.

Whether you're developing advanced AI-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you’re ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.
As a Salesforce Account Executive , you'll work closely with our VP of Sales, Enterprise, and CEO and be an integral part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, Sales team focused on the Health and Life Sciences (HLS) vertical within Salesforce.

You will manage all aspects of the sales process including lead management, creating pipeline, qualification, evaluation, close, and strong account management, and will play a vital role in the success of the overall sales team.

This is an incredible opportunity for someone who is ready to make an immediate impact in their career with a well-established brand and dive into the world of AI and Salesforce.

Perform as a key employee in the role of Account Executive, with a focus on winning new business, driving pipeline, and building trust and strong relationships with our customers
Tightly partner with the Salesforce sales and customer success organizations including: Core AE’s and SE’s in the HLS organization
Be a leader at NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture by being the “quarterback” with our customers, Salesforce employees, and internal teammates to ensure high satisfaction maintaining and growing our strong brand

Partner with Marketing, Sales Engineering, and the CEO to continually take advantage of new market opportunities

Lucid Software is the leader in visual collaboration and work acceleration, helping teams see and build the future by turning ideas into reality. Our products include the Visual Collaboration Suite (Lucidchart and Lucidspark) and airfocus.

We hold true to our core values: innovation in everything we do, passion & excellence in every area, individual empowerment, initiative and ownership, and teamwork over ego. At Lucid, we value diverse perspectives and are dedicated to creating an environment and culture that is respectful and inclusive for everyone. Lucid is a hybrid workplace.

We promote a healthy work-life balance by allowing employees to work remotely, from one of our offices, or a combination of the two depending on the needs of the role and team.
Since the company’s founding, Lucid Software has received numerous global and regional recognitions for its products, business, and workplace culture. These include being listed to the Forbes Cloud 100, Fast Company Most Innovative Companies, Fortune Best Workplaces in Technology, and PEOPLE’s Companies that Care.

Lucid’s solutions are used by more than 100 million users across the globe, making Lucid the most used visual collaboration platform by the Fortune 500. Our customers include Google, GE, and NBC Universal, and we partner with leaders such as Google, Atlassian, and Microsoft.
We’re looking for a strategic, high-performing Enterprise Expansion Account Executive (EAE) to unlock growth within our most valuable customers. This is a chance to shape how the world’s most recognizable companies collaborate, innovate, and transform.

As an EAE, you’ll own the strategy and execution across some of Lucid’s largest accounts, driving meaningful impact for our customers while growing deep, lasting partnerships. You’ll have the autonomy to run complex enterprise deals while working alongside an elite team of BDRs, CSMs, and Solutions Engineers who share your drive for excellence.

Lead growth in your territory: Expand enterprise accounts through a blend of growth, renewals, and strategic new opportunities

Be a trusted advisor: Partner with senior leaders at Fortune 500 companies to understand their goals and help them scale Lucid across the enterprise

Drive complex, high-impact deals: Navigate multi-threaded sales cycles and craft win-win negotiations that elevate customer success

Build powerful relationships: Create champions at all levels of the organization through consultative selling and thought leadership

Coach and collaborate: Mentor your assigned BDR and collaborate across Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams to deliver exceptional value

Stay connected: Travel as needed (1–3 weeks per quarter) to strengthen customer relationships in person

5+ years of sales experience in tech/SaaS (as an Account Executive, Account Manager, or similar role), with a proven record of exceeding quotas
Experience selling complex enterprise software solutions and managing long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles
Strong knowledge of SaaS/cloud applications and their business value
Ability to collaborate across functions and lead cross-team sales efforts
Exceptional communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills
Strength in prospecting, territory planning, and consultative selling

Advanced skills in Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, and other sales enablement tools
Proven experience utilizing MEDDPICC or similar value-based selling methodology to address complex customer needs in enterprise sales
Passion for SaaS and the future of work

Job Category Sales Job Details About Salesforce Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust.

And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce 's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce . K-12 East | Open Req Job Responsibilities Who we are: We’re Salesforce , the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+ Data +CRM.

Leading with our core values, we help organizations across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers and constituents in the moments that matter. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world.

If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good– you’ve come to the right place.

About the position: The Salesforce K-12 Account Executive is a subject matter expert and trusted advisor who works with K-12 institutions to evangelize our platform solutions that help every institution become an Agentic Enterprise, where humans and agents drive customer success together.

We are seeking an experienced quota-carrying sales executive who can work both as part of a broader Account Team, leading the overall account strategy and as an Individual Contributor driving self-generated sales opportunities.

If you have a passion for being at the cutting edge of how K-12 institutions engage with their constituents, we want to speak with you!

Responsibilities: - Be the subject matter expert when it comes to how K-12 institutions (Districts, CMOs, Nonprofit, and Independent Schools) leverage Salesforce solutions within their enterprise - Aggressively prospect and generate new contractual relationships with K-12 schools & districts - Develop of sales plans to effectively and efficiently cover the accounts within an assigned geography. - Collaborate with Account and Territory team members to identify target accounts - Create and drive revenue within a specified region and/or list of named accounts - Generate business opportunities through networking, cold-calling, and prospecting in to current Salesforce customers - Own the sales cycle for the entire technology stack - including lead generation, deal strategy, pricing and packaging, and assistance with deal closure - Meet and exceed all quarterly and annual sales quotas - Drive brand awareness, campaigns, and lead generation via networking, associations, etc. - Maintain accurate account and opportunity forecasting - Ensure customer satisfaction and contract retention Requirements: - A proven team player working in co-selling environment - 5+ years of enterprise EdTech sales experience - Proven track record of sales excellence working as an Individual Contributor and working in a team environment - Be able to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment in high-growth mode - Superior professional presence and business acumen - Experience selling at the "C" level –Superintendents, Chief Technology Officers, Chief Information Officer, Procurement and Executive Management. - Work collaboratively with solution engineering team to create compelling demonstration scenarios - Ability to be extremely effective via online meetings, hangouts, and conference calls - Ability to travel up to 35% of the time **This job will be posted until 8/22/2026.

Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce , you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best .

Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Fin is the AI Customer Agent company on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey – from service, to sales, to ecommerce.

Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk for one single system that is designed to meet the needs of modern day support teams.

Founded in 2011, Fin became one of the fastest growing companies and remains one of the largest private software companies in the world with nearly 30,000 global businesses using our products to transform their customer support. Driven by our core values, we push boundaries, build with speed and intensity, and relentlessly deliver incredible value to our customers.

What's the opportunity?

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Account Executive to join our team. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in propelling our new business growth in the Mid Market and Enterprise segment, leveraging your expertise to foster and maintain key client relationships. If you are passionate about consultative sales and eager to make a significant impact, this is the perfect opportunity for you.

What will I be doing?

· Product Evangelism: Champion Fin's product by driving its adoption and growth within the Mid-Market and Enterprise segment.

· Sales Cycle Management: Oversee the complete new business sales cycle for Mid-Market/Enterprise customers, from initial outbound to closing deals, utilising a consultative values based sales approach.

· Forecasting & Reporting: Deliver accurate sales forecasts and provide clear visibility on revenue performance.

· Product Knowledge: Maintain comprehensive and up-to-date knowledge of our evolving products and sales processes.

· Tailored Demonstrations: Develop and present customized product demonstrations to meet specific client needs.

· Team Development: Engage in mentoring and development activities within the sales team.

· Customer Advocacy: Represent the voice of the customer to internal stakeholders, including Marketing and Product teams.

What skills do I need?

· Sales Expertise: Minimum of 5+ years of experience as an Account Executive, with at 3+ years in Saas.

· Track Record: Proven success in meeting and exceeding sales quotas.

· Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

· Problem Solving: Strong ability to navigate and solve challenges in a fast-paced environment, handling both inbound and outbound opportunities across various industries and company sizes.

· Closing Skills: Demonstrated ability to close net new business in a competitive landscape.

· Growth Mindset: Exhibits intellectual curiosity, ambition, and a continuous learning attitude.

We are a well treated bunch, with awesome benefits! If there’s something important to you that’s not on this list, talk to us!

· Competitive salary and equity in a fast-growing start-up

· Catered lunch every weekday, plus a fully stocked kitchen

· Regular compensation reviews - we reward great work!

· Unlimited access to Claude Code and best-in-class AI tools; experimentation & building is encouraged & celebrated

· Flexible paid time off policy

· Healthcare stipend towards private health insurance for you and your partner/spouse

· MacBooks are our standard, but we also offer Windows for certain roles when needed

#LI-Hybrid

Policies

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

HubSpot Philosophy and Product
We believe the world has changed. We see businesses using more kinds of software, not less, that all needs to work together. To help our customers grow better in this environment, HubSpot is evolving from an “all-in-one” suite into an “all-on-one” platform.
HubSpot is a set of tools that supports a companies customer facing teams including Marketing, Sales and Service helping them to optimize each stage of the buyer’s journey and grow their business.
HubSpot’s flywheel philosophy uses the momentum of happy customers to drive referrals and repeat sales for our customers. We’ve also invested in an integrations ecosystem that helps customers do more with HubSpot and creates real value for people who adopt our suite of software.
What will you get to do in this Small Business Account Executive role?
As an Account Executive at HubSpot, you use inbound selling strategies to find new business and help them grow using HubSpot software. You benefit from inbound leads and partner with Business Development Reps to research prospects and create outreach strategies.

You run online demos of the HubSpot software and successfully sell the HubSpot value proposition. Your target clients will largely consist of small and mid-sized businesses. This position would be based out of your home office working in an inside sales model, and it is a full closing role.

With customers like Enpal, Flink, Personio, and Blacklane , leading companies trust our AI-native platform that automates compliance, scales effortlessly, and makes organizations audit-ready in record time. The market is growing by 20% every year , fueled by regulations like GDPR, NIS2, DORA, and the AI Act .

We are perfectly positioned to establish Kertos as the European compliance champion. There has never been a better moment to join our team. Come shape the future of compliance in Europe with us.
Your purpose at Kertos
Als Channel Sales Manager übernimmst du die Gesamtverantwortung für den Partnerkanal von Kertos – von der Pipeline bis zum Umsatz. Du baust das Ökosystem von Grund auf auf: du entscheidest, welche Partner wir angehen, gewinnst sie und machst aus diesen Beziehungen eine verlässliche, messbare Wachstumsquelle. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Sales, Marketing und Product zusammen, damit Partnerschaften kein Silo bilden, sondern echten Impact im gesamten Unternehmen erzeugen.
Auf- und Ausbau des Partnerkanals mit belastbaren, vertrauensbasierten Beziehungen zu Key-Partnern – mit dem Ziel, Umsatzwachstum zu treiben und Partner- und Kundenzufriedenheit sicherzustellen.
Rekrutierung und Onboarding kommerzieller Partner, darunter Reseller und MSSPs, sowie kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Partner-Go-to-Market-Strategie.
Entwicklung skalierbarer Prozesse zur Gewinnung, Aktivierung und langfristigen Betreuung strategischer Partner – damit das Programm strukturiert und nachhaltig wächst.

Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und lieferst Ergebnisse, auch wenn kein Playbook existiert – das ist dein bevorzugtes Umfeld, nicht dein Problem.
Deine Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten auf Entscheiderebene sind auf Deutsch und Englisch gleichermaßen stark.
Erfahrung in der Compliance-, Cybersecurity- oder Legal-Tech-Branche ist ein echtes Plus – du weißt, wer unsere Kunden sind und welche Partner für sie relevant sind.

TechQuartier For 10 years, TechQuartier has been the place in Frankfurt am Main, Germany, where the right people come together through events, programs, and accelerator initiatives to drive innovative growth.

As a key driver of innovation in Frankfurt’s financial center, TechQuartier connects FinTech and GreenTech startup founders with established companies in future-shaping fields such as AI, quantum computing, and finance. TechQuartier has been part of the Federal Digital Hub Initiative (de:hub) since its start in 2017.

In 2024, TechQuartier was officially recognized as the FinTech Hub Frankfurt within the de:hub network. TechQuartier is also the organizer and host of the IMPACT FESTIVAL in Frankfurt – Germanys largest B2B event for digital & sustainable transformation.

TechQuartier continues to advance the startup ecosystem in the Frankfurt Rhine-Main region and strengthens its role as a central innovation hotspot in Europe.
If you’re interested in taking on responsibility in a dynamic environment, contributing your own ideas, and driving innovation together with us, you’ve come to the right place.
Join our team full-time starting from january 2027 . We look forward to receiving your application.
Why this role truly makes an impact The IMPACT FESTIVAL brings together companies, start-ups, investors, and innovators to drive digital and sustainable transformation forward. To make this happen, it takes strong partners and a diverse range of exhibitors.
As a (Senior) Sales Manager , you will play a key role in acquiring new exhibitors, sponsors, and partners for the IMPACT FESTIVAL. With your instinct for business opportunities and your strong closing skills, you will directly contribute to the festival’s growth and economic success.

This role is not just about managing existing accounts, but about actively creating new opportunities, acquiring a high number of exhibitors, convincing partners, and consistently driving the sales process through to contract signing.
What you will drive forward with us You are responsible for selling our exhibitor, trade fair, sponsorship, and partnership offerings, from identifying and approaching potential customers through negotiation to contract signing.
You build a sustainable sales pipeline by combining inbound leads with proactive outbound activities to acquire new customers.
You develop existing customer relationships, identify cross- and upselling opportunities, and build long-term partnerships.
Together with the team, you further develop our sales strategy and pricing structure and identify new market opportunities.
You confidently lead negotiations with decision-makers, with a strong focus on closing deals, and develop tailored offers.
You ensure a structured handover to the onboarding and account management process and support it as needed.
You manage and document your sales activities in our CRM (Pipedrive) and use the data gained to manage, analyze, and optimize the pipeline.
You work closely with the IMPACT FESTIVAL team and other relevant departments at TechQuartier, ensuring smooth coordination and collaboration.
What you bring to the table You have several years of experience in B2B sales, ideally in the trade fair, conference, event, or sponsorship industry.
You have a proven track record in acquiring new customers and experience in successfully driving complex sales processes through to closing.
You have a strong understanding of customer needs and market potential and bring experience in developing, implementing, and optimizing sales strategies and pricing structures.
You are a strong communicator, approachable, and confident when interacting with a wide range of stakeholders. You communicate fluently in both German and English.
You have strong negotiation skills, take initiative, and work in a structured and goal-oriented manner, while keeping track of multiple sales processes running in parallel.
You are eager to learn and bring a hands-on mentality and a solution-oriented approach.
You are confident working with CRM systems; experience with Pipedrive is a plus.
You are passionate about sustainability, digitalization, and innovation.
Not required, but definitely helpful
You have experience working in a startup or coworking environment and are familiar with the dynamics of agile work cultures.
What awaits you with us Team-Spirit: We are an open‑minded, dedicated, and international team that truly embraces innovation and entrepreneurship. To spark new and creative solutions, we value diverse opinions and perspectives.
Innovation Hub: You will work in a modern and inspiring environment at the heart of Frankfurt’s start‑up ecosystem. Through constant exchange with start‑ups, you’ll discover new trends and technologies, build valuable connections, and take part in numerous events at TechQuartier.
Ownership: From day one, you’ll take responsibility for your own projects, make decisions, and actively shape the future of TechQuartier.
Career & Development: We foster a transparent learning and feedback culture. Clear career levels, skill profiles, and plenty of room for your own ideas help you strengthen your talents and grow personally and professionally.
Flexibility: With your own laptop and a Deutschlandticket, you’re well equipped. Thanks to the option to work partially remote and flexible working hours within our core time, you can organize your day in the way that makes you most productive.
Benefits: 30 days of vacation plus additional days off on Christmas Eve, New Year’s Eve, and your birthday; a company pension plan; shopping and fitness discounts; regular team events; and free drinks.
We look for potential, not perfect CVs Does the job posting sound exciting to you, but you don’t meet every listed requirement? Please keep in mind that these requirements are just a starting point. We’re looking for people with drive, a willingness to learn, and a desire to take on responsibility. Let’s talk and see if we’re a good fit.

Final decision & job offer

This is an early-in-career opportunity intended for candidates with limited professional experience.
The CSAM is an **early-in-career Customer Success Account Manager **who delivers standardized customer success outcomes spanning executive partnership, solution health, cloud adoption, and AI acceleration activities. These CSAMs act within a pod model.
Working under the direction of senior CSAMs and a Manager, the CSAM operates within a defined pod covering a shared portfolio of accounts. The role contributes to portfolio-level intelligence, execution orchestration, and reactive signal aggregation - reducing context-switching for senior CSAMs and accelerating customer outcomes.
This is a talent-engine role: CSAMs are AI-first, customer-facing from month three, and grow through structured cohorts and community.

## Executive partnership and execution ##
* Execute standardized executive partnership, solution health, cloud adoption, and AI acceleration tasks under direct guidance from senior CSAMs or CSU leaders.
* Support agent and Copilot adoption motions across assigned pod accounts.
* Complete assigned activities accurately and on time; escalate exceptions rather than independently diagnose them.
## Portfolio-level intelligence and preparation ##
* Maintain deep, current account context across the pod-s defined portfolio.
* Synthesize account signals into -what-s changed / what matters now-
* Detect risks, upcoming deliveries, upcoming milestones, and open threads.
* Detect portfolio patterns such as recurring blockers across multiple accounts.
## Execution orchestration (not delivery) ##
* Track delivery and milestone progress with partners and CSAs on behalf of senior CSAMs.
* Map dependencies across workloads and milestones.
* Proactively flag drift before the customer raises it.
* Coordinate remediation follow-ups across internal teams.
## Reactive signal aggregation ##
* Monitor reactive support signals - case volume, aging, repeat drivers - across the pod portfolio.
* Aggregate reactive trends into portfolio-level views and surface early warnings of escalation risk.
* Track follow-through on Support, IM, and Service Manager commitments; chase stalled internal owners.
* Distill reactive noise into CSAM-ready insights, not raw data.
## Operating model ##
* Operate within a pod model covering a shared portfolio of accounts.
* Work under direct oversight of the Manager and senior CSAMs assigned to the pod.
* Limit interactions to task execution and information capture; executive partnership and account governance is led by the senior CSAM.

## Required ##
* Bachelor-s degree (any discipline) or equivalent early-career experience.
* 0-2 years of professional experience in program management, customer-facing operations, technology delivery, or analytics.
* Demonstrated comfort with AI tools and AI-first ways of working.
* Strong written and verbal communication in English plus the language(s) required for the assigned hub.
* Legally authorised to work in the location where this role is based - Zurich, Switzerland (Legally authorised = you hold citizenship or have been granted a valid visa or work permit.) Relocation expenses are not provided as part of this role.
* Fluency in English must be mandatory
* Fluency in French AND/OR German is mandatory

* Coursework or experience in program management, business operations
* Exposure to enterprise software, cloud platforms, or B2B customer success.
* Experience working in pod, squad, or matrixed team structures.

Dutchie aims to further support the positive societal change the cannabis industry brings to the world through wellness benefits, social justice, and empowering local communities through tax revenue.

Data privacy has become one of the most strategic challenges facing modern enterprises, sitting at the intersection of AI governance, data operations, and customer trust. As companies adopt AI at scale, they need new ways to automate privacy and manage risk without slowing innovation. DataGrail has launched the first agentic privacy platform, and we're entering a pivotal phase of growth as we scale toward the next stage of the business.
As a Mid-Market Account Executive , you'll own the full sales cycle in a segment with strong win rates and fast, 30 to 40 day sales cycles. There's a real market appetite for what we sell, giving you the opportunity to build your own pipeline, lead a challenger-style, insight-driven sales process, and quickly build momentum toward your first-year quota.
This team has consistently delivered strong results quarter over quarter, and you're joining a motion with a proven track record. Sales cycles here are measured in weeks, not the year-plus timelines common in enterprise sales, so you'll see the impact of your work sooner.
AI adoption is pushing privacy and governance higher on the priority list for the kinds of companies you'll be selling to, and DataGrail's product keeps pulling ahead of the competition. That combination gives you a strong foundation to build on from day one.

Build and manage a self-sourced pipeline at 3x coverage against quota, largely through your own outbound.
Run a challenger-style sales process: lead with insight, create urgency, and keep deals moving through a compressed 30 to 40 day cycle.
Identify and develop champions inside target accounts who advocate for you and carry deals forward internally.
Negotiate pricing and contract terms quickly and confidently, protecting deal momentum without stalling progress.
Manage your full-cycle pipeline with disciplined forecasting and CRM hygiene, from first outreach through close.
Ramp quickly on DataGrail's product, ICP, and sales process, contributing to pipeline within your first 90 days.

A proven track record as a hunter, having built pipeline largely from scratch through your own outbound effort.
Comfort running a challenger sales style: you bring insight and create urgency rather than waiting for the buyer to move.
Experience identifying and developing champions who move deals forward internally, even when you're not in the room.
Challenges prospects' current thinking by connecting data privacy gaps to real business risk, pushing the conversation beyond features and into impact.
Command of a modern sales methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or similar) and the discipline to qualify rigorously and forecast accurately.
Strong, agile negotiation skills, closing terms quickly without losing deal momentum.
A track record of consistent quota attainment in full-cycle B2B SaaS sales, with experience navigating a high-velocity, mid-market sales motion. Specific numbers seem like something we should discuss in initial interviews.
A coachable mindset and the ability to take feedback and adjust quickly, especially during ramp.

Experience selling privacy, data governance, security, compliance, or other regulated or technical software.
Experience selling to privacy, legal, security, or IT stakeholders at the VP or Director level.
Familiarity with a modern GTM tech stack (Salesforce, Gong, sales engagement tooling) and comfort using AI to work smarter.
What Success Looks Like

Complete onboarding and develop deep fluency in DataGrail's platform, the privacy landscape, and our competitive differentiation.
Begin generating qualified pipeline and running discovery calls with strong command of the message.
Build pipeline at 3x coverage against a prorated quota with 1 to 2 deals already closed.

Own a healthy, well-qualified pipeline with multiple opportunities actively advancing through stage.
Maintain 3x pipeline coverage against your full quota.
Close your first new-business deals and demonstrate consistent, accurate forecasting.

Consistently meet or exceed your annual quota in new ARR through a repeatable, largely self-sourced pipeline motion.
Own a defined book of mid-market accounts with a clear plan for continued penetration and growth.
Develop multi-quarter account plans for your top mid-market accounts, identifying paths to expansion and long-term value beyond the initial deal.

Antenna is the leading provider of data and analytics for subscription media services in the U.S. Antenna's standardized metrics, competitive benchmarks, syndicated insights, and market intelligence are trusted by some of the most recognized and respected brands across media and entertainment sectors.

Using a proprietary AI-powered approach, Antenna connects subscription activities with real consumer viewership to provide services, studios, and creators with an unmatched, market-wide view of subscriber behaviors to better understand acquisition, retention, and engagement.
We're looking for a Strategic Account Director to drive expansion revenue, deepen our footprint within our largest media and entertainment accounts, and own how we grow strategic enterprise relationships.

You will partner directly with executive leadership to set account strategy, build expansion roadmaps, mobilize cross-functional resources, and close the renewals and expansions that fuel Antenna's next phase of growth.

You will deepen Antenna's engagement with VP and C-suite executives at the world's largest tech and media companies, translating complex data into clear business value. You will shift from landing initial expansion to growing each enterprise account.
You will report to our VP, Client Services. Antenna is a remote-first company, and we are looking for candidates who can work during US business hours. Preferably, you should be based in a US time zone (Eastern, Central, Mountain, or Pacific).

Own Enterprise Relationships & Revenue: Own executive relationships (VP+) at enterprise accounts to significantly grow revenue, hit renewal/expansion targets, and ensure clients realize ROI to become trusted advocates.
Drive Strategic Account Planning: Build and own long-term strategic account plans, mapping out multi-quarter expansion roadmaps that balance short-term wins with a long-term product vision.
Partner with Customer Success and Insights: Collaborate closely with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) as your account partners and Insights & Analytics team as your insight partners; leverage their day-to-day insights, data expertise, and user relationships to identify upsell opportunities and strategic executive intros, while hunting for new internal relationships to pass back to the CSM team.
Lead Renewal & Deal Execution: Own the end-to-end renewal strategy with a 90-day runway, while managing client expectations and ensuring internal alignment throughout the entire deal cycle.
Uncover & Execute New Opportunities: Conduct client discovery for advanced solutions and new products in development, running use-case and value-proposition deep dives to expand Antenna’s footprint.

Enterprise & Executive Sales Expert: You have a proven track record of executing high-velocity, consultative new business sales, building multi-threaded relationships with VP and C-suite executives, and delivering white-glove service.
Data & Product Literate: You are comfortable selling complex, multi-SKU data products and working with Product/Engineering teams. You speak the language of programming, audience measurement, and subscriber growth, translating data into the strategic questions Media & Entertainment leaders care about (launches, pricing, bundling, content slates).
The Ultimate Collaborative Partner: You thrive in shared-ownership environments. You excel at collaborating with internal account leads and Customer Success to drive unified outcomes and expansion, bringing a mentorship approach to team members like CSMs and Insights Analysts.
Trusted Client Advisor: You are the partner clients text when they hit a problem, and the person they introduce to their broader internal teams because you anticipate risk and manage escalations while protecting the relationship.
Commercial & Negotiation Savvy: You negotiate effectively with a sharp understanding of business finance, budgets, contract terms, and ROI to close complex deals.

Antenna is the leading provider of data and analytics for the U.S. Subscription Economy. Our standardized metrics, competitive benchmarks, syndicated insights, and market intelligence are used by some of the most trusted brands across media and entertainment sectors to better understand subscriber behavior and successfully navigate the rapidly changing consumer subscription landscape.

Qualtrics is on the lookout for a proactive, collaborative seller that can help us lead and own the strategy for selling Experience Management (XM) SaaS within the largest accounts in the Danish market. We’ve seen great success in Denmark and are continuing to build out our presence in the region.

We’re looking for a highly driven, results-oriented individual who values urgency, speed and action. The ideal candidate for this role takes extreme ownership and brings a strong hunger to build pipeline, get things done and win. This is a fully remote position. We’re helping the world’s leading companies improve experiences.

Our solutions allow our clients to have a 360° view of the entire experience enabling them to uncover what matters most to clients and employees with the ability to take action in real time.
How You’ll Find Success
Relationship Building: Master stakeholder mapping to cultivate relationships with multiple contacts within an account, ensuring lasting partnerships.
Negotiation Skills: Navigate negotiations with professionalism, understanding the art of give-and-take.
Multi-Selling Approach: Drive engagement with various business stakeholders in parallel to create multifaceted selling opportunities.
Empathetic Competitiveness: While being competitive, possess the ability to empathise and understand others’ perspectives.
Entrepreneurial Mindset: Take initiative to grasp the expected outcomes and context, working independently to drive results.
How You’ll Grow
By joining Qualtrics, you become part of a revolutionary team committed to shaping groundbreaking experiences.
You will help us expand the XM category beyond where it is today with more advanced use cases & pioneering advancements in AI.
Our mission is to build technology that positively impacts businesses and makes them more human.
Competitive base salary, uncapped commissions, and aggressive accelerators for over-performance.
Things You’ll Do
Focus on acquiring new business and sell the Qualtrics Platform to key accounts.
Develop comprehensive account plans, from power maps to demand generation and closing strategies.
Manage relationships between Qualtrics and senior executives of both client and prospect companies.
Lead commercial negotiations for multi-year enterprise agreements, skillfully navigating the procurement, legal, and security landscapes typical of the industry.
Build compelling business cases that demonstrate clear ROI and value for clients.
Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of Qualtrics’ solution offerings.
